scorecard.notes: Composite is median-ish across five evaluators. Totals were 8/12/17/12/13. Gate is REJECT because two evaluators rejected.

A priority queue + capability labels reproduces the fixture; all-tie is scored inconclusive so MeshyAnts stays unfalsified by default.
Compare can emit meshyants_advantage without event-amplification gates.

bootstrap_ci_95 is a stub; execution, mismatch, and manager policy are still invented by the next agent.
